Resamples a raster to a new cell size, on the same extent, with the chosen interpolation.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Resampling, Resolution<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterResolutionResampler`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inGeodata` | raster file |  |  | The raster to resample. |
| `pInterpolation` | String |  | `nearest neightbour` | The interpolation of the new cells: nearest neighbour keeps the original values, as needed for classes and codes; bilinear and bicubic smooth them. Allowed values: `nearest neightbour`, `bilinear`, `bicubic`. |
| `pXres` | Double |  |  | The new cell size in x. |
| `pYres` | Double |  |  | The new cell size in y; if not set, the one in x. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outGeodata` | output file |  | The resampled raster. |
